card.name: Inside surnames and foreign proper names
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a person's surname or foreign proper name, most strongly the piece "mer" in names like Larmer, Elmer and Schermerhorn. It appears in citations and names of authors, conductors and places.

modes.description: The piece "mer" sits in the middle of an author's surname.

modes.label: Other name pieces
modes.description: Middle pieces of foreign personal or place names, such as "ze", "zer" or "no".
modes.example: German conductor Kurt-Heinz Stol<<ze>> to arrange and orchestrate
